entities.name: Aeve, Progenitor Ooze
entities.description: An ancient ooze from an unknown plane, the first living being of its world and unchanged for billions of years.

events.summary: A lightning flash strikes a primordial soup and Aeve emerges as the first living being on the plane.
events.quote: From that single jolt emerged Aeve, the very first living being to inhabit this world.
